By the year 851, the island had been cleared of Pure Titans thanks to the use of the Executioner from Hell devices, allowing its inhabitants to roam freely outside the Walls.

Key threads from this canonical page lead to Wall Maria, Wall Rose, Wall Sina, Survey Corps, Attack on Titan (manga) and Mikasa Ackerman. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

page.overview:
What is Paradis Island?

By the year 851, the island had been cleared of Pure Titans thanks to the use of the Executioner from Hell devices, allowing its inhabitants to roam freely outside the Walls.

Following Eren Yeager's initiation of the Rumbling, civilization advances on the island for many years before it is eventually destroyed by war.

Late into the history of the Eldian Empire, Karl Fritz, the 145th monarch of the Fritz family, chose to abandon the conflict over the Nine Titans between the subservient Eldian families on the continental mainland. Karl, ashamed of Eldia and its history of persecuting Marley conspired with the Tybur family to ensure Marley would win the conflict and overthrow the Empire while he moved the capital of Eldia to Paradis, a remote island at the time. In the King's absence, the Great Titan War continued to cripple the Eldian Empire as the eight Titan families would engage in an endless cycle of conspiracy and betrayal. As Eldia lost more and more territory to the Marleyans as Karl wanted, the King gathered as many people and members of the royal family as was possible before turning various of them into Colossus Titans to form three centric Walls around their last piece of undisputed territory in the year 743. At the same time Karl used the Founding Titan to erase the memories of his people so they would believe the entire human race except for them were devoured by the Titans.

When this proved ineffective on the Oriental and Ackerman bloodlines, Karl ordered their extermination in fear they would disrupt his vision of "peace". those who survived fled into hiding in places such as the underground beneath Paradis' capital of Mitras or in the isolated wildernesses beyond the towns.

Also known as: Paradis.
